examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The Retail page's band: the storefront pitch beside a scrolling wall of eight deploy templates, closed by a ticker of compatible frameworks and clouds. Marks flagged `invertInDark` invert under the dark theme. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no templates renders nothing at all.
